parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The consumer group ID. This ID is returned after you call [CreateConsumerGroup](~~170388~~) to create a consumer group. You can call [QueryConsumerGroupList](~~170419~~) to query the consumer group ID by consumer group name. You can also view the consumer group ID in the IoT Platform console by navigating to the corresponding instance and choosing **Message Forwarding** > **Server-side Subscription** > **Consumer Groups**.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
